name: Gap and go
idea: A signal when the session opens beyond the prior high (or low), every close of the opening window holds beyond it, and the window ends at or beyond the open: the gap kept going. The idea is wrong back through the level the gap cleared.

params.label: The level the gap clears
params.help: The previous session's high (or low), or the high (or low) of the recent month of sessions.
choice_labels: The previous session's high or low
The high or low of the recent month of sessions

params.label: Opening window (minutes)
params.help: Every close in this many minutes from the session's open must stay beyond the level; the signal comes on the bar that ends the window. It must be a whole number of the chart's bars.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level the gap cleared, or that level with a buffer.
choice_labels: Just beyond the level the gap cleared

params.label: Level buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the level the gap cleared': how many average true ranges beyond it.

constraints.message: The opening window must be a whole number of the chart's bars (for example 15, 30 or 45 minutes on the 15-minute chart).
